# PTS News: RIP Legacies (New PTS Dec 2022)

![](/uploads/ajaxGallery_45_nukaknights-post-ptsriplegacies.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

## Update December 22, 2022: New PTS with active Energy Explo filter

The Energy Explo Filter is also active again on the current PTS, which went online yesterday on December 21st, 2022. This time apparently without the previous errors. Enclave plasma rifles have e.g. nor their legendary effects. Only the Explo effect on energy weapons has been disabled and is no longer listed.

![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-pts-legacy-filter-youtube.jpg)

## Update November 17, 2022: New video from PTS

Energy weapons now have the Explo effect again, but it no longer works. Explo now only works on weapons with bullets as projectiles. Proper names weapons have their effects normal again and enclave plasmas are also normal again.
![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-template-stillriplegacies.png)

## Post from November 11, 2022

If you don't read the PTS thread (Facebook), I want to give you some spoilers. It's over. All mods that no longer drop have been disabled on the PTS.

**Youtube video** from today at the PTS (demonstration of the BE Laser without Explo):
![](/uploads/nukaknights-post-ptsriplegacies-youtube.png)

## PATCH NOTES:

**-Gameplay:** Weapon mods attached to weapons that cannot be obtained through natural gameplay have been removed from their weapons.

- 
**NOTE FROM THE DEVS:** This is to ensure that every player is using and trading the same items and has the same advantages as everyone else. Most players will not notice any impact to their existing weapons. Weapons with these illegal mods will remain in the players inventory, but the mod itself will be destroyed.

Source: https://fallout.bethesda.net/.../fallout-76-nuka-world-on...

## Community feedback

Most feedback on this change is positive. Of course, some are dissatisfied because the Energy Explo weapons are sacred to them. Some even refuse to believe this news at all. You can read some of the feedback in this Facebook thread: https://www.facebook.com/groups/nukaknights/posts/1115870015730182/

Back in January we started a survey on Facebook asking whether players wanted to continue or stop if this change occurred. Here 91% were of the opinion to continue playing and only 9% wanted to stop. We'll see how it develops:
![Survey: Legacy Nerf](/uploads/wahl-2233.png)
